instruction: A small chapel apse: a half-cylindrical semicircular stone end wall with several tall arched windows, exterior buttresses between the windows, and a half-conical roof. Honest meter scale, simple masonry.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a chapel apse. A small chapel apse: a half-cylindrical semicircular stone end wall with several tall arched windows, exterior buttresses between the windows, and a half-conical roof. Honest meter scale, simple masonry. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
